photoshootEditor.title: Photo editor
photoshootEditor.sub: Crop, straighten, brightness and contrast, remove a small spot, or ask for finishing to run again.

history.d: Every editing session saved for this picture, most recent first. Nothing here changes the picture yet — the actual crop/rotate/brightness and the finishing re-run are done by a later step.

form.noPicture: No picture ready for this image yet.
form.straightenHelp: Negative tilts left, positive tilts right.
form.rerunHint: The finishing pass (upscale, repair, shadow, colour grade, sharpen) will run again on this picture once it is picked up.
form.rerunNotGenerated: Only offered on a picture the Studio itself generated — never on a real original.
form.nothingToSave: Change something first — nothing to save yet.

err.SOURCE_INVALID: This edit cannot be saved for this picture.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — the page may need a refresh.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
